title: Watersound 61 Compass Point Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Golf Cart- Private pool- Fourth floor observation deck- Fully appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances- 6 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout- This property come with 4 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 4 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Premium location meets Coastal New England design! This gorgeous, newly constructed 3-story, 6-bedroom, 6-bath WaterSound getaway has it all: a private pool, golf cart, and spectacular outdoor living spaces—and it’s just a short walk to the quartz-sand beaches of the Emerald Coast. It even has Gulf views!The chef’s kitchen on the first floor features premium stainless appliances, marble countertops, and a vast island with seating for 4. The kitchen opens onto a dining area with seating for 8, as well as a living room with exposed ceiling timber accents and a flatscreen TV—the perfect venue for vacation movie night. Glass French doors and an abundance of windows allow for plenty of natural light. Open the sweeping glass sliding doors and the kitchen give onto a vast indoor/outdoor area complete with a flatscreen TV, making it the perfect place to entertain or to gather for game day. A few steps away is the private gated pool, which will keep everyone cool throughout the day. A comfortable set of chaise lounge chairs makes it as comfortable as it is fun. The first floor has a primary bedroom with a king bed and a private bath with a shower only. Ascending to the second floor, you come to a second living room with a flatscreen television. Just off this area is a second primary bedroom with a king bed and a private bath with a shower and tub. The second floor is also home to 3 guest bedrooms—all with king beds and beautifully appointed private baths with showers only. The second floor also has a laundry room with a front-loading washer and dryer.Moving up to the third floor, you’ll find an additional bedroom with twin-over-twin bunks and a shared bath with a tub/shower combo—the perfect accommodations for the young and the young at heart. Perhaps the most compelling amenity of this amenity-rich retreat is the incredible crow’s nest. Take in serene Gulf views and share evening cocktails with loved ones from this incredible vantage point.The premium location cannot be overlooked. A golf cart along with 6 adult bikes allow guests to explore this gated community. This WaterSound retreat sleeps 14. Don’t miss your chance to unwind at this one-of-a-kind vacation home. Call to book 61 Compass Point Way today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerSECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerTHIRD FLOOR: - Additional Living: Two Twin over Twin Bunks, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboIMPORTANT INFORMATION *Walton County regulations require all doors leading to private pools to have an alarm that sounds when the door is slightly open (ajar). This alarm needs to be manually turned off when exiting the pool area. *Elevator is not available for guest use.*This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.
